# 🚀 NeuralOps v1.4.2: Universal Shebang Standard & Production PyPI Release

NeuralOps v1.4.2 delivers the complete universal shebang standard across all 1,481 Python source files, expanded automated GitHub CI workflows, and the official live PyPI distribution.

## 🌟 Key Highlights
- **Universal Shebang Standard**: Exact `#!/usr/bin/env python3` prepended to line 1 of all 1,481 Python source files.
- **Hardened CI/CD Quality Gates**: Added standalone GitHub Actions workflows for Quality Gate, Serving Benchmarks, and Compression Engine testing.
- **Official PyPI Distribution**: Certified packaging and live distribution published on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/neuralops/1.4.2/).
- **Native NeuralOps Agent Skills**: 10 repository-local skills in `.agents/skills/` tailored to NeuralOps GPU profiling, autotuning, and Triton-to-Gluon porting.

## 📦 Installation
```bash
pip install neuralops==1.4.2
```
